ref: Full-body cinematic photo of a young woman in her twenties of mixed European and East Asian appearance, dark brown hair pulled back in a low ponytail, blue eyes, white tank top, an orange jumpsuit with its top half tied around her waist by the sleeves, orange trousers with darker knee patches, a white wristband, wearing sci-fi long-fall boots: tall glossy white knee-high boots, each with a curved white spring blade fixed to the back of the calf that sweeps down behind and below the heel, lifting her heel off the floor, a shock absorber that cushions falls, holding a large portal gun the length of a rifle, held in both hands like a rifle at hip level: a glossy white rounded rear shell, a thick black ribbed cylindrical barrel, three thin black curved claw prongs around the muzzle, a glowing blue core inside the barrel. She stands calmly in the middle of a bright sterile white test chamber of square white wall panels with thin dark seams and grey metal floor tiles, facing the camera, neutral deadpan expression, whole body in frame head to boots, sharp focus on her face. Photoreal cinematic film still, anamorphic, no text, no logos.
ai_wake: Wide low-angle shot of an enormous robot hanging from the ceiling of a vast dark cylindrical chamber: a long curved segmented black mechanical spine wrapped in thick black cables with thin orange stripes, white curved armour plates along it, ending in a glossy white rounded capsule-shaped head that hangs down, with one small glowing warm yellow optic in a dark horizontal slot on its face plate. Volumetric light shafts, haze, menacing and graceful. Photoreal cinematic film still, anamorphic, no text, no logos.

sentries: A row of slim white pill-shaped sentry robots about knee height, each standing on three thin black legs, a single glowing red eye in the middle of each body projecting a thin red laser beam through the haze, in a dim white test chamber. Polite and deadly. Photoreal cinematic film still, anamorphic, no text, no logos.
portals: A bright white sterile test chamber of square panels. On the far wall: a glowing otherworldly portal shaped as a tall vertical oval exactly twice as tall as it is wide, its rim a bright roiling ring of fire-like swirling energy with flickering flames and sparks, the inside a clear window showing a different room, unreal and luminous, burning bright blue. On the grey floor, seen in perspective: a second such portal burning bright orange. Photoreal cinematic film still, anamorphic, no text, no logos.
